faqs.question: Where should I start?
faqs.answer: Tell us the type of sofa, what needs attention and the result you have in mind. The enquiry form below sends those details to the team. Availability and suitability need to be confirmed before any service is agreed.

faqs.question: Can I share photographs?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can attach one photograph to this enquiry, or start a WhatsApp conversation and share more images there. Include a full view and, if possible, a close-up of the problem.

faqs.question: Can I ask about a different fabric or cushion filling?
faqs.answer: Include the fabric, colour or feel you are looking for in your message. Ask the team which options are available for your particular sofa before choosing a specification.

faqs.question: How is the quote decided?
faqs.answer: A useful starting point is your sofa’s size, its condition and the work you would like considered. Request an assessment first; the scope, materials, price and any arrangements must be agreed with the team.
